title: Circuit test point
statement: Let $C$ be an arithmetic circuit on $n$ inputs and let $r$ be a finite Boolean string. The test point associated with $C$ and $r$ is the point in $\mathbb N^n$ whose $i$th coordinate is one plus the value of the block of $r$ assigned to input $i$, using blocks of length determined by the size of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is an arithmetic circuit on $n$ inputs
Coordinate $i$ is obtained by adding one to the block value using block length determined by $C$'s size
caveat: The snippet does not include definitions of `blockVal`, `inputBits`, or circuit size, so the exact block-value convention is unavailable.
